About

A portfolio built around progress.

A clearer story about what I care about and where I'm heading.

Bridging technology, markets & creation.

My interests sit at the intersection of technology, digital creation and financial markets. Crypto trading has taught me to think in systems, manage uncertainty and keep learning from data and experience.

I also enjoy building practical web and digital projects. This portfolio is part of that process: a place to turn ideas into something useful, measurable and presentable.

  • Curiosity over assumptions
  • Consistency over shortcuts
  • Practical projects over empty claims
